description: This file defines API endpoints for a FastAPI application related to flood risk prediction, terrain segmentation, sponge zone detection, and geojson generation. It utilizes multiple ML models to process images and climate data, providing structured responses for each prediction task.

classes.name: FloodRiskRequest
classes.description: Request schema for flood risk prediction, containing climate index sequences.

classes.name: FloodRiskResponse
classes.description: Response schema for flood risk predictions, including rainfall and flood probability.

classes.name: SegmentationResponse
classes.description: Response schema containing segmentation mask and proportions for terrain analysis.

classes.name: TerrainAnalysisResponse
classes.description: Combination response schema including segmentation results and sponge zones analysis.

classes.name: GeoJSONFeatureCollection
classes.description: Schema for GeoJSON features representing sponge zones.

methods.name: FloodRiskResponse predict_flood_risk(req: FloodRiskRequest)
methods.description: API endpoint for running the flood risk model A to predict next-month rainfall and flood probability.

methods.name: SegmentationResponse predict_segmentation_api(file: UploadFile = File(...))
methods.description: API endpoint to run the terrain segmentation model B on uploaded image files.

methods.name: TerrainAnalysisResponse predict_terrain_analysis( file: UploadFile = File(...), include_mask: bool = Query( default=True, description="If false, the API will still compute zones but return an empty mask to reduce payload size.", ), )
methods.description: API endpoint to perform combined terrain segmentation and sponge-zone detection.

methods.name: GeoJSONFeatureCollection predict_sponge_zones_geojson(file: UploadFile = File(...))
methods.description: API endpoint to generate GeoJSON polygons of sponge zones based on image segmentation.

ctags.signature: ( file: UploadFile = File(...), include_mask: bool = Query( default=True, description="If false, the API will still compute zones but return an empty mask to reduce payload size.", ), )
